subject: Physics
title: Thermodynamics
summary: Zeroth law: do systems agar teesre ke saath thermal equilibrium mein hain to aapas mein bhi equilibrium mein hain — isi se temperature ka matlab banta hai.
First law: ΔQ = ΔU + ΔW (di gayi heat = internal energy mein badhat + gas dwara kiya work). Ideal gas ka U sirf temperature par depend karta hai.
Gas ka work = P–V curve ke neeche ka area. Isothermal, adiabatic, isobaric aur isochoric processes ke apne seedhe formulas hain.
Second law: heat apne aap thande se garam ki taraf nahi behti, aur koi cyclic process heat ko poori tarah work mein nahi badal sakta. Asli processes irreversible hote hain.

formulas.name: First law of thermodynamics
formulas.mistake: Sign convention: gas ko di heat +, gas dwara work +. Conventions mix mat karo.

formulas.name: Work done by a gas
formulas.formula: W = ∫ P dV = area under the P–V curve
formulas.when: P–V diagram par koi bhi process.
formulas.mistake: Cycle mein work = enclosed area (P–V par clockwise → positive work) — direction check karo.

formulas.name: Internal energy of an ideal gas
formulas.formula: ΔU = n Cv ΔT  (for ANY process)
formulas.mistake: ΔU sirf ΔT par depend — non-isochoric process mein bhi nCvΔT hi lagao.

formulas.name: Isothermal process (T constant)
formulas.formula: PV = constant;  ΔU = 0;  W = Q = nRT ln(V₂/V₁) = 2.303 nRT log(V₂/V₁)
formulas.when: Reservoir ke contact mein dheemi processes.

formulas.name: Adiabatic process (Q = 0)
formulas.formula: PVᵞ = constant;  TVᵞ⁻¹ = constant;  W = (P₁V₁ − P₂V₂)/(γ − 1) = nR(T₁ − T₂)/(γ − 1)
formulas.mistake: Adiabatic curve (slope −γP/V) isothermal (−P/V) se zyada steep — confuse mat karo.

formulas.name: Mayer's relation and γ
formulas.when: Dono molar heat capacities ko jodna.

formulas.name: Values of Cv and γ
formulas.formula: monoatomic: Cv = 3R/2, γ = 5/3;  diatomic (rigid): Cv = 5R/2, γ = 7/5;  polyatomic (non-linear, rigid): Cv = 3R, γ = 4/3

formulas.name: Fraction of heat turned into work (isobaric)
formulas.when: Diatomic gas: heat ka 2/7 work banta hai.

formulas.name: Cyclic process
formulas.formula: ΔU = 0 over a cycle ⇒ Q_net = W_net = area of the loop

examples.title: Isothermal expansion
examples.problem: 2 mol ideal gas 300 K par isothermally double volume tak failti hai. Work (ln 2 = 0.693)?
examples.solution: W = nRT ln 2 = 2 × 8.314 × 300 × 0.693 ≈ 3458 J (= absorbed heat, kyunki ΔU = 0).

examples.title: Adiabatic compression
examples.problem: 300 K ki monoatomic gas adiabatically 1/8 volume tak dabaayi. Final temperature?

examples.title: Diatomic gas ka isobaric heating
examples.problem: 2 mol diatomic gas constant pressure par 50 K garam. Q, W aur ΔU?

examples.title: Constant pressure par work
examples.problem: Gas 10⁵ Pa par 1 L se 3 L tak failti hai. Work?

examples.title: Adiabatic pressure change
examples.problem: Diatomic gas (γ = 1.4) adiabatically aadhe volume tak. Pressure kitna guna?

examples.title: Ek line mein first law
examples.problem: Gas 500 J heat leti hai aur 200 J work karti hai. Internal energy ka change?
examples.solution: ΔU = Q − W = 500 − 200 = 300 J (temperature badhta hai).

examples.title: Triangular cycle ka work
examples.problem: Gas A(P₀, V₀) → B(2P₀, V₀) → C(2P₀, 2V₀) → seedhi line se wapas A; P₀ = 10⁵ Pa, V₀ = 1 L. Net work?
examples.solution: Work = triangle ka area = ½ × V₀ × P₀ = ½ × 10⁻³ × 10⁵ = 50 J.

examples.title: Mixture ka γ
examples.problem: 1 mol monoatomic + 1 mol rigid diatomic gas. Mixture ka γ?

topics.title: System, surroundings and state
topics.explain: System woh hissa jise hum padhte hain; baaki sab surroundings. State variables (P, V, T, U) equilibrium states batate hain. Extensive variables size par depend (V, U, mass); intensive nahi (P, T, density).

topics.title: Thermal equilibrium and the zeroth law
topics.explain: A agar C ke saath equilibrium mein hai aur B bhi C ke saath, to A aur B bhi equilibrium mein. Thermometer isi law se kaam karta hai.

topics.title: Heat, work and internal energy
topics.explain: Heat aur work transit mein energy hain aur path par depend karte hain. Internal energy state function hai: ideal gas mein sirf molecules ki kinetic energy, sirf T par depend.

topics.title: Reading P–V diagrams
topics.explain: Isobaric: horizontal line; isochoric: vertical line; isothermal: hyperbola; adiabatic: zyada steep curve. Expansion (V badhe) → W positive; compression → W negative.

topics.title: Quasi-static processes
topics.explain: Itni dheemi process ki system hamesha equilibrium mein rahe. Sirf quasi-static processes P–V par curve ki tarah ban sakte hain aur reversible ho sakte hain.

topics.title: Reversible and irreversible processes
topics.explain: Reversible process ulti chal sakti hai aur system aur surroundings dono bilkul shuru ki haalat mein laut aate hain. Friction, free expansion, finite temperature difference par heat flow aur mixing processes ko irreversible banate hain. Saari natural processes irreversible hain.

topics.title: Second law of thermodynamics
topics.explain: Kelvin–Planck: aisi koi process nahi jiska ek-maatra result heat ko poora work mein badalna ho. Clausius: aisi koi process nahi jiska ek-maatra result thande se garam body tak heat bhejna ho. Dono statements equivalent hain.

topics.title: Syllabus note
topics.explain: Current NTA syllabus mein zeroth, first, second law, processes aur reversible/irreversible processes hain. Heat engine/refrigerator details aur Carnot cycle alag se nahi likhe, isliye first law aur P–V work sabse zyada practise karo.

ratta: ΔQ = ΔU + ΔW;  ΔU = nCvΔT always.
Isothermal: W = nRT ln(V₂/V₁);  adiabatic: PVᵞ = const, W = nRΔT/(γ − 1).
Work = area under P–V;  cycle → area enclosed.
